title: Lecture — 10 introductory transactions
description: The ten transactions from slide 33 of the Accounting 101 lecture. Owner investment, equipment, rent, sales on credit, loan, and so on.

title: Practice A — Coffee shop
description: A small café in its first month: opening capital, rent, espresso machine, beans on credit, sales, wages, utilities, prepayment from a catering customer.

title: Practice B — Freelancer
description: A solo consultant: laptop, software subscriptions, sales on invoice, VAT prepayment, partial collection of receivables.

title: Practice C — Online retailer
description: An e-commerce shop: warehouse rent, inventory on credit, sales, returns, courier costs, payment processor fees.
